name: melee_small
verifies: fix-51: the hero's sword lands on small and low creatures as in G3 (weapon trigger, shape group 7: from 0.5 m below the feet to 2 m+ up), on flat ground and on the snowy Nordmar slope (Hammerclan path, 18-33 deg): a goblin pack and a meatbug. Each 'fight X:' line gives swings vs touched (touched should be about the swings, never 0); the hero keeps the weapon drawn between the goblins of a pack ('keeps the weapon drawn: N hostiles near')
notes: fix-64: a meatbug is an ambient creature and flees (G3 IsAmbientCreature, CombatAiRules.NeverFights): it is held still (freeze only=) since the test is the blade's reach, not a chase; the fight op swings from the target's size (ScenarioPacing.MeleeReach). hp=5 per target, so the first touch kills. A swing that touched nothing logs '[CombatFighter] ... closest gap ... trigger y ...' (LogLunges). On the slope the spawns land up- and downhill of the hero (dy in the fight line). fix-120 (r42 'expect !drawn: was True', 'keeps the weapon drawn: 2 hostiles near' after the slope meatbug): Nordmar ice wolves and sabertooths roam in from beyond the first calm (80 m) during the goblin fights and attack; a wider calm before the meatbug keeps the end of the test about the sheathe (not a sheathe race: SheatheAfterFight kept the weapon drawn for real attackers, as a player would).
